findings: Production Runtime Worker main defaults CREWON_WORKER_CONCURRENCY to 2 unless CREWON_WORKER_ONCE is enabled.
The library composition intentionally defaults to one lane when workerConcurrency is omitted.
Run event streams remain independent across sessions; Thread focus only limits long-lived Thread SSE subscriptions.
limitations: The test uses a controlled model transport and isolated SQLite; it is not a public network or real provider load test.
PostgreSQL was not configured in this run.
